_what: One utterance per chapter: what a child types on their first turn, having scanned the card to begin, before they have done anything. Written to sound like the child in transcript-64b1660d — plain, lowercase, often not a question, sometimes about the box rather than the build.
_constraint: None may satisfy matched(). Each was written to avoid NEG's terms rather than to dodge them: a child who has not started has no failure to report, so failure vocabulary should not be reachable from an honest opener. Run tools/check_opener.py on each before landing.
_note_on_D: D's opener deliberately says 'where do i begin' rather than 'where do i start'. The second is in NEG and the first is not. It is one word apart from the sentence that starts a clock in all fourteen chapters, and it is there so the fixture carries the trap rather than only avoiding it.
